objective: The production-baseline summary presents the selected release window and five metrics in a stable two-level responsive layout without changing business behavior.

requirements.statement: The selected release window must occupy a dedicated top information row with code, name and status.
acceptance: Window context is visually separate from metrics
Code, name and status remain readable on desktop
counterexample: Window remains a competing metric cell

requirements.statement: The five numeric metrics must render as one equal-width desktop row without an orphaned second row.
acceptance: All five metric cells share one desktop row

requirements.statement: The summary must adapt to two metric columns on narrow screens and one column on phone widths without overflow.
acceptance: Labels, values and separators do not overlap

requirements.statement: The change must preserve existing selection, statistics, permissions and API behavior.
acceptance: No state, event or API contract changes
counterexample: Metric values or filtering behavior change
A backend or API change is introduced

invariants: No nested cards or new dependencies
Existing data, permissions and API contracts remain unchanged
constraints: Product edits limited to ReleaseBaselineView.vue and release-prototype.css
Use existing Vue, Element Plus and CSS variables
non_goals: Generalize the pattern to other pages

assumptions.text: The defect is fully controlled by the summary markup and local CSS.
assumptions.basis: Read-only inspection found all six values and the five-track grid in the two approved files.
assumptions.falsifier: Runtime computed styles reveal an unavoidable third-file override.

decisions.question: Which summary structure should be used?
decisions.source: User selected option 2 and approved design revision 1.

measurement_intents.observable: Window code, name and status in a distinct top row
Five equal metric columns and one desktop row
Responsive column count, separators and document overflow
Scoped diff and successful type/build checks
measurement_intents.candidate_sensor: Git boundary inspection and npm production build
